messages:
sara-eng: Heads-up — vendor just told us the A100 rack scheduled for eu-west1-b is delayed ~48h. Can we do a last-minute swap and run the odin-loadtest canary on H100s instead? Need ~8 GPUs for a 4h window tomorrow 08:00-12:00 CET. PR with infra changes: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123. Who can confirm quota + network access?

chong: I can check quotas now. Which exact zone are we targeting — eu-west1-b or -c?

sara-eng: eu-west1-b. Preferred is all in b, but if quota blocks us, fallback plan is 4 H100 (b) + 4 H100 (c). Lower latency if all in one zone but cross-zone is acceptable for the test.

vendor-tracker-bot: vendor update: Order ORD-7791 status -> delayed_shipment (ETA +48h). Affected racks: eu-west1-b. Contact vendor-ops@external.com for expedited options.

maria: Procurement note — we do have an outstanding PO that covers H100s but it references a different staging pool. I'll ping vendor ops to check hot-swap. @kelly-procure FYI.

kelly-procure: Just pinged vendor ops, asked for expedited staging to eu-west1-b and to confirm whether NL-STG-12 rack can be re-targeted. Will update when they reply.

pranav: Quota quick-check: project/redwood-odin currently has 0 H100 quota in eu-west1 (per-zone). I can submit a quota bump request but GCP auto-approve usually takes 2-6h, manual >6h. Recommend opening request immediately.

sasha: I'm project owner, approving the request now. Also reminder: firewall tags need to be in the PR so infra can open smoke-test ports.

sara-eng: PR already includes tags + canary flag. snippet:
```hcl
resource "google_compute_instance" "canary" {
  count = 4
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
  tags = ["odin-canary","smoke-test"]
}
```

chong: If quota bump doesn't land in time, alternative is cross-zone: spin up 4 H100 in eu-west1-b and 4 H100 in eu-west1-c to spread per-zone limits. Slightly more network jitter but fine for loadtest. Anyone object?

maria: fine with cross-zone for this canary, go ahead.

oncall: Oncall note — if you change zones please update canary alert rules (alert label: canary/odin). I can open a small PR to retarget dashboards unless you want to.

sara-eng: Please open the PR, thanks. Also need a volunteer to run the smoke harness. I can lead at 09:00 CET but will need backup at 09:30.

pranav: I'll run the smoke at 09:30 CET and collect traces. Assigning to @pranav.

chong: Quota request submitted: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?request=Q-9982 — requested 8 H100 in eu-west1 (zone split option included). Estimated auto-approve 2-4h.

vendor-tracker-bot: vendor note: alternate rack NL-STG-12 (same sku) available for staging, can target eu-west1 in ~6h if vendor expedites.

sara-eng: OK — thanks all. Plan: wait 2-4h for quota; if denied, switch cross-zone profile. @kelly-procure keep vendor ops pinging. I'll post another status update in ~2h. :thumbsup:
